structured_output.what_is_happening: GROYPER (9GGV…paid) is a 10-day-old pump.fun token that has migrated to PumpSwap. It was launched through usepaid.app with the description "Fees to @nickjfuentes", so creator fees are routed to Nick Fuentes's X account. The coin sat dormant, then in the last hour it rose about 300%, with about $30k of its $37k one-hour volume in the last 5 minutes, at roughly $35k market cap. At the same moment several brand-new "Groyper" pump.fun coins launched about 45–50 minutes ago are each doing $36k–$117k of one-hour volume on the bonding curve. That points to a short Groyper/Fuentes ticker wave right now. I could not find the trigger (a Fuentes post or stream is plausible). This older fee-share coin looks like a rotation play: it is migrated, has burned LP, and sends fees to Nick himself.

narrative.description: Groyper meme and Nick Fuentes's movement, with creator fees routed to Fuentes's X account via usepaid. Fuentes has a large audience (about 1.2M X followers, livestreams around 1M views per Media Matters) and has had heavy media coverage in 2026. Crypto frog/Groyper coins recur often.
narrative.why_spreading: Several fresh Groyper coins were launched about 45 minutes before detection with very high volume, which suggests something current (probably Fuentes content) set off a ticker wave. I could not identify the specific catalyst in search.

token_connection.why_this_token: Its angle is fees to @nickjfuentes via usepaid. It is migrated with burned LP, so it is sturdier than the fresh curve coins. It is not an official Fuentes project, and I found no evidence he has acknowledged it or claimed the fees.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are many. AjgSv…pump (older, $175k market cap, $73k liquidity) is the most established Solana Groyper. Others include 7QAn5 ($60k market cap), 2iDwr, and at least 6 new curve coins from the last hour with $36k–$117k of one-hour volume. Ticker demand is split across all of them.

authenticity.evidence: GeckoTerminal shows 139 unique buyers vs 96 sellers in the last hour, and GMGN tags 56 smart and 6 renowned (KOL) wallets among traders. Against that, GMGN also tags 379 bundler wallets, a 60% bot/degen rate and a 29% top-bundler trader share. Almost all volume came in the last 5 minutes. No paid DexScreener boosts. My web searches found no organic posts about this contract.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X data, the catalyst is unknown, and I could not tell whether KOL wallets are buying or just rotating through.

structural_risks: Only about $16k of liquidity at $35k market cap, so it is thin and sells hit price hard
Already up about 4x within an hour of entry, so late buyers are exit liquidity
Attention is split with many same-ticker coins
Creator has closed their position (creator_close) and has 4 prior launches; the dev's X account is linked to 176 launches

structured_output.counterargument: If Fuentes posted about or claimed the fees on this specific coin, it would be the de facto canonical fee-share Groyper. From $35k market cap it could easily reach $70k+ (its all-time high implies about $140k) within hours, and the smart and KOL wallets present could mean it is being positioned for exactly that.
unknowns: What set off the Groyper wave in the last hour

source_coverage.notes: Searching the contract address returned nothing relevant. Searching the ticker returned only older and competing Groyper coins. The news found covers Fuentes and the Groypers in general, not a specific event in the last hour. The usepaid.app page failed with an SSL error. I ran out of time before searching Telegram or Discord.

structured_output.thesis: This is a revived fee-share coin catching a spillover bid from a live Groyper ticker wave. It has a real narrative hook and a sturdy structure (LP burned, authorities renounced), but it is not canonical, it is already up about 4x in the hour, the flow is bot-heavy, and many copies compete for the same money. Doubling from entry needs the wave to keep going; late entries into bot-driven pumps more often retrace.
